headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.80
summary: Fixes the launch hang during native mod loading and the logcat export button that did nothing.

items.text: Fixed the launch hang at native mod loading: the log hook is now detached while game and mod libraries load.
Fixed the logcat export button doing nothing when tapped; it now always opens the share sheet.
Per-mod breadcrumbs (cached copy, System.load, init) so a stalled launch can be pinpointed from the overlay timestamps.
